intents.title: Promote manually committed turns
intents.statement: A ready turn whose trailer resolves to a reachable commit becomes committed with its commit_sha and committed_at filled, and a turn_committed_manual ledger event is appended. The turn record is a projection; the ledger is the record.

intents.title: Promotion runs once and never guesses
intents.statement: Only ready turns with no recorded commit are candidates. A turn with no matching trailer stays untouched, and a second run promotes nothing. Promotion happens before reconcile so a freshly promoted turn is evaluated as committed.

intents.title: Tell the agent what was promoted
intents.statement: turn.begin reports the promoted turns in its briefing so the agent sees that prior manual commits have been adopted into the ledger.
